title: AI agent swarm solves Navier-Stokes

tellings.quote: No single Astra agent or GPT agent can solve the uh problem for us. M >> but then when you get 10,000 agents and you give them 88 hours suddenly boom there is a solution.

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026, says that a huge team of AI programs cracked the Navier-Stokes problem, a famously hard set of equations describing how fluids like water and air move. He says no single AI agent, meaning a program that works on a task by itself, could solve it, but 10,000 of them working together for 88 hours suddenly found a solution. If true, it would show that swarms of AI can reach answers no single mind or machine could.
